text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The spring Tenno Sho comes to an<n>end with a
cascade of cheers.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek puts on an incredible<n>race, leaving a
strong impression on<n>Tamamo Cross.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Despite losing, her intimidating aura<n>shakes
Tamamo Cross to her core.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross witnesses Super<n>Creek race with a
seriousness she's<n>never seen before...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She then realizes that Super Creek<n>has finally found
her own reason to<n>run.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap awaits Super Creek at her<n>next race, the
autumn Tenno Sho.
